workstationId = value["wksID"]
	db = value["db"]
	
	query = """
	SELECT 
	    ws.ID                              AS WorkstationID,
	    n.ID                               AS NodeID,
	    p.ID                               AS PapoID,
	    p.Description                      AS PapoName,
	    p.Reference                        AS Reference,
	    lastRH.[User]                      AS [User],
	    lastRH.[Timestamp]                 AS [Timestamp],
	    lastRH.[Status]                    AS [Status],
	    lastRH.Action                      AS Action,
	    DATEDIFF(MINUTE, lastRH.[Timestamp], GETDATE()) AS MinutesSince
	FROM [workstation] ws
	JOIN [workstationnode] wsn ON wsn.WorkstationID = ws.ID
	JOIN [node] n              ON n.ID = wsn.NodeID
	JOIN [papo] p              ON p.NodeID = n.ID
	
	OUTER APPLY (
	    SELECT TOP (1)
	        rh.[User],
	        rh.[Timestamp],
	        rh.[Status],
	        rt.[Description] AS Action
	    FROM [registerhistory] rh
	    JOIN [registertype]  rt ON rt.ID = rh.RegisterTypeID
	    WHERE rh.WorkstationNodeID = wsn.ID
	      AND rh.PapoID            = p.ID
	    ORDER BY rh.[Timestamp] DESC
	) AS lastRH
	
	WHERE ws.ID = ?
	ORDER BY CASE WHEN lastRH.[Timestamp] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
	         lastRH.[Timestamp] DESC,
	         p.ID;
	"""
	
	args = [workstationId]
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(query, args, db)
	
	rows = []
	if ds:
	    for i in range(ds.getRowCount()):
	        ts = ds.getValueAt(i, "Timestamp")
	        ts_str = system.date.format(ts, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss") if ts is not None else None
	        rows.append({
	            "workstationID": ds.getValueAt(i, "WorkstationID"),
	            "nodeID":        ds.getValueAt(i, "NodeID"),
	            "papoID":        ds.getValueAt(i, "PapoID"),
	            "name":          ds.getValueAt(i, "PapoName"),
	            "reference":     ds.getValueAt(i, "Reference"),
	            "action":        ds.getValueAt(i, "Action"),
	            "status":        ds.getValueAt(i, "Status"),
	            "user":          ds.getValueAt(i, "User"),
	            "timestamp":     ts_str,
	            "minutesSince":  int(ds.getValueAt(i, "MinutesSince") or 0),
	        })
	
	# Para el repeater: devolver lista de objetos
	return rows
